Exercise 3 of 4
Scenarios: Apply the 10x Model
26 points

📋 Scenario

Your sales director messages you at 2pm: "We're going head-to-head with Competitor X tomorrow morning. Can you get me a battlecard by end of day?"

In the past, this would take 6-8 hours. You have 4 hours. Using the 10x PMM approach, what's your best workflow?

📋 Scenario 2

Your CEO asks you to "create a new category" for your product — she wants to own the narrative before competitors catch up. You have 2 weeks.

Based on the AI Impact Matrix, how should you approach this?
